costs.method: Deterministic fixtures make zero provider calls and use zero tokens; hosting/development are not allocated here.

limits: Public new API not connected: HTTP 503. Static files staged only; runtime not installed on VPS.
Observed shared disk reserve about 1.09 GiB; recheck before importing runtime.
Synthetic rule-policy evaluation is not evidence of real-world diagnostic accuracy or LLM reasoning.
Single-process in-memory ownership/quotas/runs; restart discards runs and sessions.
No live AgentOps inference, cross-project business events or KnowledgeOps lookup implemented or verified.
Hosting/development cost per run unmeasured; benchmark is local ASGI, not VPS capacity.
Independent review, owner acceptance, public HTTPS end-to-end and native VPS health probe remain unverified.
